findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a new TestLogger instance, discarding logged entries
findings.body: `TestLogger.FromContext` returns `NewTestLogger()` instead of returning the receiver `f` (or propagating recorded logs to `f`). In `LoggerMiddleware.logRequest` (`pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/logger_middleware.go:58`), logging was changed from `m.logger.Info(...)` to `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)`. When a `*TestLogger` is passed to `NewLoggerMiddleware`, `m.logger.FromContext(ctx)` returns a temporary `TestLogger` whose `InfoLogs` are immediately discarded, leaving `InfoLogs` on the caller's `TestLogger` instance empty (`Calls == 0`) and breaking tests that assert on `LoggerMiddleware` logs. In addition, `TestLogger.FromContext` ignores `ctx`, so contextual attributes added via `log.WithContextualAttributes` are lost.

findings.title: LoggerMiddleware tests are not updated and ContextualLoggerMiddleware has no unit tests
findings.body: `LoggerMiddleware.logRequest` removed explicit `pluginId`, `endpoint`, `uname`, `traceID`, `dsName`, and `dsUID` log parameters, relying instead on `ContextualLoggerMiddleware` to populate `ctx` and `m.logger.FromContext(ctx)` to read them. However, `logger_middleware_test.go` was not updated to reflect that `LoggerMiddleware` alone no longer emits these fields, and no unit tests were added for `ContextualLoggerMiddleware` (`contextual_logger_middleware.go`) to verify that `QueryData`, `CallResource`, `CheckHealth`, and `CollectMetrics` populate the context with the expected attributes.

findings.title: ContextualLoggerMiddleware dereferences req without checking for nil
findings.body: `ContextualLoggerMiddleware.QueryData`, `CallResource`, `CheckHealth`, and `CollectMetrics` (lines 39-57) dereference `req.PluginContext` without checking `if req == nil`. `LoggerMiddleware` explicitly guards against `req == nil` on each of those methods (`logger_middleware.go` lines 63, 77, 90, and 104), but because `ContextualLoggerMiddleware` is registered ahead of `LoggerMiddleware` in `CreateMiddlewares` (`pluginsintegration.go:160-161`), passing a `nil` request will now panic in `ContextualLoggerMiddleware` before reaching `LoggerMiddleware`.
